name: Venezuelan Sign Language
world_status: accessible description is silent on stress

earlier_scan.note: Sign language; Glottolog refs are lexicostatistical/sociolinguistic; no word-stress description located

sources.citation: Oviedo, A., Rumbos, H. & Pérez H., Y. 2004. El estudio de la Lengua de Señas Venezolana. In F. Freites & F. J. Pérez (eds.), Las disciplinas lingüísticas en Venezuela, 201-233. Maracaibo: Universidad Católica Cecilio Acosta (web republication on cultura-sorda.org). [= Glottolog ref 548855 'Freites & Perez 2004']
sources.note: Research survey of LSV linguistics (structure of signs, morphology, syntax, acquisition, literacy). Mentions 'prosodia' only in a general remark about spoken-language structuralism; lists no study of LSV prosody, rhythm or stress.

sources.citation: Oviedo, Alejandro. 2000 [edición revisada y aumentada 2003]. Un estudio sobre la estructura de las señas de la Lengua de Señas Venezolana. Mérida: Universidad de Los Andes. Libro inédito, publicado con fines docentes en cultura-sorda.eu (2007), 6 parts (56 pp. of PDF).
sources.note: Nothing. It is a sublexical (Liddell-Johnson Movement/Hold) description of LSV signs: handshape features, location, orientation, contour/non-contour movements, M/D segment durations, non-manual features. a full-text search for stress/accent acento/prosodia/ritmo/suprasegmental/sílaba gives only incidental hits (e.g. a locative sign's movement 'terminar de modo acentuado sobre un punto del espacio', Parte 6 p.106); no statement on stress/prominence.
